description_en: Modifies the switch status of container proactive defense interception policies
description_zh: 修改容器主动防御拦截策略开关
name: ModifyInterceptionRuleSwitch

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster that you want to modify.
You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的集群的ID。
您可以调用[DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The switch status of the rule. Valid values:

1: Enabled.
0: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则的开关状态。取值：

1：表示开启。
0：表示关闭
parameters.name: rule_switch

parameters.help_en:
The list of rule IDs to operate on. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
You can call the [ListInterceptionRulePage](~~ListInterceptionRulePage~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
需要操作的规则ID列表，多个ID用英文逗号（,）分隔。
您可以调用[ListInterceptionRulePage](~~ListInterceptionRulePage~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: rule_ids

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each API request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
